string.text: Stalkers Cover Spacing To Allies' Cover (m) (ai_cover_ally_spacing)

NPCs refuse a cover this close to a cover that an ally of the same faction already holds or is running to, unless they are clearly closer to it than he is to his. A cover just outside this distance of an ally's still costs a little, so a free spot wins.
 
0 = off (old behaviour).
 
Default: 4.0.
Stalkers Cover Spacing To Coverless Allies (m) (ai_cover_body_spacing)

NPCs refuse a cover this close to a teammate who is fighting with no cover of his own, when the spot is nearer to him than to them.
 
0 = off (old behaviour).
 
Default: 2.5.

When an NPC finds no cover at all, he stands this far to the left or right of the nearest teammate in the fight, instead of queueing right behind him.
 
0 = off (old behaviour: 1.2 m behind a teammate).
 
Default: 3.5.
Stalkers Cover Spacing Counts The Whole Faction (ai_cover_spacing_scope)
ON: every ally of the same faction on the level counts for cover spacing. OFF: only the NPC's own engine group.\n \nDefault: ON.
If enabled, the log gets "[COVER]" lines: which NPC was refused or steered away from a cover because of an ally, and each no-cover side step. For testing only.\n \nDefault: OFF.
Stalkers Stop Sneaking When Shot At (ai_sudden_attack_break_on_fire)

If enabled, an NPC that is sneaking up on an enemy who has not seen him gives the sneaking up and fights normally as soon as he is hit or a bullet lands within 5 m of him.
Default: ON.
